title: Runtime
description: One runtime's config file, .troupe/runtimes/<name>.yaml: a service a runner talks to. The file's name is the runtime's name. It holds only what the theatre's config sets: a built-in runtime's other fields are troupe's defaults, and the person's environment overrides any of them (TROUPE_RUNTIME_<NAME>_ENDPOINT, _MODEL, _CREDENTIAL_ENV). troupe writes this file from the theatre's config events, and every field is set with troupe config set.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Where this file's schema is, so editors can check it. troupe writes it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The base URL the runner's API is served under: http or https, a host and an optional port and path, with no user info, query or fragment. The runner adds its own paths. Required for a runtime that isn't built in.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model a run uses when its actor sets none, as the service names it.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: Where the runtime's credential comes from. Never the credential itself: config is committed, so it holds only a reference.

env.title: Environment variable
env.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the credential, read from the person's environment when a run starts. It can't be one of troupe's own (TROUPE_...).

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: What each model costs at this service, by the model's name exactly as a run names it, in US dollars per million tokens. A runner whose service reports no cost estimates one from the run's model's price, marked as an estimate; a model with no price gets none. Set a rate for every kind of token the service's runs use, cacheRead and cacheWrite included (0 for a kind it doesn't charge for), or runs that use it get no estimate. In a config set path, a model's name that holds a dot goes in brackets: runtimes.openai.prices[gpt-4.1].
